Layer: GRD episodes of the same year and panel
Question it answers: What share of recorded hospital activity documents an F84?
Compatible numerators: episodes with F84 in any position, principal F84, strict hospitalisation and MAS
Uses not permitted: not a population: it yields neither prevalence nor individual risk

Unit of observation: resident by comuna, age and sex
Question it answers: How many recorded events are there per 100,000 resident population?
Compatible numerators: numerators with declared residence; place-of-care numerators only with an explicit note
Uses not permitted: never combined with the 2024 census without a flag; not used for establishment rates

Question it answers: What share of the population is covered by public insurance?
Compatible numerators: insurance layer; coverage context for the REM and GRD series
Uses not permitted: not a residence denominator; mixes APS enrolment and address

Question it answers: What share of the population is outside the public system?
Compatible numerators: insurance complement; context for interpreting public coverage
Uses not permitted: has no comparable autism numerator; never used as a denominator for the REM series

Unit of observation: person enrolled in a primary-care centre
Question it answers: What is the operational coverage of the centre that reports the REM?
Compatible numerators: denominator of the primary-care series (A03, A05, P6, P2) by centre
Uses not permitted: not a resident population; age groups and variable names change in 2024

Question it answers: How much hospital activity and capacity lies behind the counts?
Compatible numerators: activity intensity; panel of 188 establishments with 12 months in every year
Uses not permitted: never a covered population nor a denominator for population rates

Unit of observation: establishment with at least one row of the code in the period
Question it answers: How much of the change is explained by reporting expansion?
Compatible numerators: offset of the REM models and mandatory companion of every REM figure
Uses not permitted: not a population; an establishment reporting zero counts as reporting

Unit of observation: PIE programme student; person under NANEAS control
Question it answers: What share of the programme corresponds to autism?
Compatible numerators: ASD/NANEAS proportion only from December 2023 (P2501878); PIE series by definition
Uses not permitted: never crossed with the health series as though they were the same people
